name: Sweden: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Sweden package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure present (EU v2.0 or Läkemedelsverket Swedish template), with a section for every population pathway in the plan, unless the user decided the protocol already contains all required information (DECISIONS.md D2).
K2 recruitment material present for every recruitment tool.
One L1 information and consent set per population in population_sets whose trigger is true.
L2 other participant-facing material present for every diary, leaflet, card, instruction or questionnaire given to participants or representatives.
For every Swedish site and responsible investigator: M1 CV, M2 declaration of interests, N1 site suitability.
O1 documentation of the applicable participant protection (insurance or other arrangement).
O2 proof of other coverage.
P1 financial and other arrangements, including participant compensation and investigator, site and funding arrangements.
Fee-related document and invoicing information as instructed by Läkemedelsverket.
R1 Swedish statement on compliance with national requirements for personal data.
S1 biological-sample compliance document.
Parallel biobank application prepared with the Regional Biobank Centre (outside CTIS) and consistent with S1.
Swedish protocol synopsis (Annex I point 24) present in Part I or recorded as a Part I source (outside_part_ii).
Sites, principal investigators and planned participant numbers in CTIS match M1, M2 and N1.
Every Annex I point 59-73 document and every participant-facing document is in Swedish; English only for an insurer-issued certificate where accepted.
A controlled Swedish country version exists for every affected document of a multinational trial; no Swedish and English duplicates of the same document are uploaded.
No signatures in uploaded K1, K2, L, M, P, R and S documents unless the current template's fields require them; participant documents are blank.
N1 issued by the head of clinic or institution or another responsible person, using the template's signature or approval fields.
Compensation amounts, methods and conditions identical in P1, K2 and every participant document.
Insurer, cover and injury-compensation wording identical in O1/O2 and every participant document.
Sample types, storage, transfers, retention and future use identical in S1, the protocol, the participant documents and the biobank application.
Data flows, recipients, transfers and retention identical in R1, the participant documents and the protocol.
Consent pathways and who obtains consent in K1 match the L1 sets and the protocol.
Versions referenced in the protocol and K1 match the uploaded participant documents.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Swedish national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Sweden is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B-S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document; the fee document in the CTIS area Läkemedelsverket instructs (DECISIONS.md D4).
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Sweden receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised CTIS transparency rules; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).

Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material, irreversibly and unsearchably; author metadata removed; signatures never disclosed.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
The package was reviewed once from the participant's perspective and once from the assessor's perspective (SE-QC#10).
